previous_entries.claim_zh: 同一历史的变化描述可在明确误差界内组合，并支持逐项条件判断；精确总量仍可能遗漏具体损失，组织变化可使旧描述失效。取得证据后的付费、耗时修订可改变实际回应，但校准与有限支持仍可使其失败，固定回应也可成功。
previous_entries.claim_en: Changing descriptions of one history compose under explicit error bounds and support indexed condition judgments; exact totals can still omit particular losses, and organizational change can defeat an earlier description. Acquired, paid and delayed revision can change the enacted response, while calibration and finite support can defeat it and a fixed response can also succeed.
previous_entries.scope_zh: 原21项尺度定理＋后续27项修订定理；明确局部法则、校准和阈值根据；独立的身体／选择研究另计，非经验或普遍伦理证明
previous_entries.scope_en: Original 21 scale plus 27 revision theorems; explicit local laws, calibration and threshold warrant; separate embodied-choice work counted separately; no empirical or universal ethical proof

previous_entries.title_zh: 尺度近似与条件传递的形式检查

previous_entries.claim_zh: 有限时域误差递推、两尺度组合、指标校准和条件传递经过实查，并保留耦合变化、误差累积及总量丢失局部条件的反例。后续检查实际证据取得、描述修订、误差余量与回应，保留耗时、读数偏差、工作耗尽及支持不足的失败和固定回应成功。
previous_entries.claim_en: Checked finite-horizon error propagation, two-scale composition, readout calibration and condition transport retain counterexamples for changed coupling, accumulated error and local conditions lost by exact totals. Continuation checks actual acquisition, revision, error margins and response, retaining delay, sensor bias, exhausted work, insufficient support and a successful fixed response.
previous_entries.scope_zh: 原21项／42项继承审计；后续27项／106项继承审计，继承结果不重复计新；标准逻辑，无任意尺度发现或普遍控制合成
previous_entries.scope_en: Original 21 / 42 inherited audits; continuation 27 / 106 inherited audits, without counting inherited results as new; standard logic, no arbitrary scale discovery or universal controller synthesis
